title: Reverse tensor operations with edge-local VJPs
description: A quick reference for the tensor reverse-mode, VJP, and graph-lifecycle terms used here.

terms.definition: A graph recording tensor operations and context needed for reverse differentiation.
A product mapping an upstream adjoint into one parent contribution.
A conceptual matrix of all output derivatives with respect to inputs.
One recorded occurrence of a parent tensor consumed by an operation.
The objective sensitivity arriving at an operation's output tensor.
The accumulated objective sensitivity restored to an input tensor's shape.
Summing reused output coordinates back into their original input coordinates.
A reverse rule that reinserts and broadcasts a reduced axis, dividing by its extent for a mean.
An explicit output cotangent matching a tensor-valued result's exact shape.
Keeping saved operation context available for another backward traversal.
